name: biomedical-manuscript-skills
description: Evidence-centered biomedical manuscript workflows and research review skills.

interface.longDescription: Sixteen evidence-centered skills for biomedical research questions, literature searches, evidence synthesis, manuscript writing and review, meta-analysis, and submission. They preserve missing and contradictory evidence, verification depth, uncertainty, and human review.
defaultPrompt: Use the relevant biomedical workflow skill for my research task.
